decisive_items: developed lower back pain and a tingling sensation radiating along the posterior aspect of her bilateral lower extremities
0/5 strength of the bilateral lower extremities (MRC scale)
Abnormal T2 cord signal from T8 to T9 disc level downwards to the conus medullaris
response.rationale: Acute onset after surfing with rapidly progressive paraplegia and long-segment cord T2 signal without enhancement, plus negative CSF and angiogram, best fits a non-inflammatory spinal cord injury. Transverse myelitis is contradicted by negative CSF and lack of enhancement; compression is unsupported by imaging.

rejected.why: Negative CSF for inflammatory/infectious etiologies and no significant contrast enhancement argue against inflammatory transverse myelitis.
No imaging evidence of mechanical compression; abnormal T2 cord signal alone does not establish spinal cord compression.
